input.story: Mujhe court se summons aaya hai, bank ne loan recovery ka case kiya hai, hearing 28 November 2026 ko hai. Kya karun?

output.masked_story: Mujhe court se summons aaya hai, bank ne loan recovery ka case kiya hai, hearing 28 November 2026 ko hai. Kya karun?

case.summary: The user received a court summons regarding a loan recovery case filed by a bank. The hearing is scheduled for 28 November 2026. The user is seeking guidance on how to proceed.
case.user_goal: Understand the summons and know the next steps to take before the hearing.

timeline.event: Received court summons for loan recovery case

evidence_missing: Bank statements showing loan disbursement and repayments
Any previous communication or demand letters from the bank

deadline_mentioned.what: Court hearing for loan recovery case

follow_up_questions: Aap kis state aur city mein rehte hain?
Summons mein bank ka naam aur case number kya likha hai?
Kya aapke paas loan agreement ya bank se koi purani letter hai?
Kya aapne abhi tak kisi lawyer se baat ki hai?

flags.message: A court process has started. Court deadlines are strict - get a lawyer now, even if only to file a reply.
There is a deadline on 2026-11-28 - within 15 days. Get a lawyer now.

notes: Not enough numbers to calculate. Tell me the amounts involved.
Interest on delayed money may be claimable; the rate is for a lawyer/court to decide, so we don't add it here.

assessment.where_you_stand: Aapke khilaaf bank ne court mein loan recovery case file kiya hai aur aapko summons mila hai. Aapke paas abhi sirf summons hai, lekin loan agreement, bank statements aur purani letters missing hain, jo aapki defense ke liye bahut zaroori hain. Court hearing 28 November 2026 ko hai, jo ki abhi 15 din ke andar hai. Aapki position abhi weak hai kyunki aapke paas proof nahi hai ki aapne kitna paisa diya ya kya bank ne galat calculation ki hai. Aapko abhi lawyer ki zaroorat hai kyunki court process shuru ho chuka hai aur deadlines strict hain.

options.title: Lawyer se turant baat karein
options.what_to_do: Kisi local lawyer se milne ka arrangement karein jo court cases handle karta hai. Unhe summons aur jo bhi documents hain dikhayein. Agar aapke paas paisa nahi hai, toh District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) se free lawyer le sakte hain [KB:lsa_s12_legal_aid].
needs: Income proof (agar DLSA se free lawyer lena hai)

options.title: Bank se documents maangein
options.what_to_do: Bank ke branch ya customer care ko likh kar (email/letter) loan agreement, bank statements aur saare demand letters maangein. In documents mein aapko pata chalega ki bank ne kitna paisa diya, aapne kitna wapas kiya, aur kya calculation sahi hai.

options.title: Court mein reply file karwayein
options.what_to_do: Lawyer ke saath mil kar court mein apna reply file karwayein. Isme aap bank ke claims ko challenge kar sakte hain agar unke paas proof nahi hai ya calculation galat hai. Agar aap court mein nahi jaate, toh case aapke khilaaf ho sakta hai.

proof_tips: Bank se likh kar (email ya registered post) loan agreement aur bank statements maangein. Isse aapke paas proof ho jayega ki aapne kitna paisa diya.
Agar aapne kabhi bhi bank ko letter ya email bheja tha, toh unke screenshots ya copies nikal lein.
Apne bank account ki statements nikal lein jo dikhate hain ki aapne EMIs ya installments kaise diye.
what_i_dont_know: Aap kis state aur city mein rehte hain (is se pata chalega ki kaunsi court hai aur DLSA kaunsa hai).
Summons mein bank ka naam aur case number kya hai.
Kya aapke paas loan agreement ya bank se koi purani letter hai.
Kya aapne abhi tak kisi lawyer se baat ki hai.
assessment.needs_lawyer_reason: Court process shuru ho chuka hai aur hearing 28 November 2026 ko hai, jo ki abhi 15 din ke andar hai. Court deadlines strict hain aur agar aap lawyer ke bina court mein nahi jaate, toh case aapke khilaaf ho sakta hai. Aapko abhi lawyer ki zaroorat hai.
assessment.reply: Aapke khilaaf bank ne court mein loan recovery case file kiya hai aur aapko summons mila hai. Hearing 28 November 2026 ko hai, jo ki abhi 15 din ke andar hai. Aapko abhi lawyer ki zaroorat hai kyunki court process shuru ho chuka hai aur deadlines strict hain. Agar aapke paas paisa nahi hai, toh District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) se free lawyer le sakte hain.
